entries.en: Humanity acquired a highly advanced information technology known as Mana. With this power of magic, the problems of war, hunger and pollution were solved, and humanity lived in peace, in a world that could be called an ideal society.

entries.en: But those born unable to use this power were called Norma by the people who could use Mana, and suffered inhuman discrimination. Anyone identified as a Norma was sent to Arzenal, a Norma detention facility on a remote island. It was also a military base for fighting the DRAGONs, giant aggressive creatures that threatened world peace. There, Norma were sentenced to fight DRAGONs until they died.

entries.en: Naomi was assigned to the First Squadron of Para-mails as a mail-rider, piloting a Para-mail, a humanoid mobile weapon and the only means of opposing the DRAGONs. But during her first machine test, she encountered a surprise DRAGON attack and crashed, losing consciousness.

entries.en: When Naomi awoke, a new mail-rider, Ange, had been assigned to the unit. Ange's arrival had sent morale among the riders plummeting. The squadron was on the verge of falling apart.

entries.en: Naomi — Voice: Sayuri Hara. A rookie mail-rider assigned to the First Squadron after graduating from Arzenal's youth division. Because of an incident, she is saddled with an enormous debt and runs around Arzenal every day to repay it. She enjoys working together with her friends so they can survive, and tries to improve relationships within the First Squadron.

entries.en: Ange — Voice: Nana Mizuki. The first imperial princess of the Empire of Misurugi, loved by her people as Angelise. When she is discovered to be a Norma, she loses her status and name, and fights DRAGONs as the First Squadron rider Ange. Raised as a princess, she is proud and inflexible. She clashes with those around her at every turn on the base.

entries.en: Vivian — Voice: Houko Kuwashima. A First Squadron assault trooper and the squadron's ace, with astonishing battlefield skills. Normally, though, she is a cheerful, easygoing girl. She asks silly quizzes and unilaterally decides whether other people are her friends based on their answers.

entries.en: Battlefields are large and time is limited, so moving quickly is essential. Save time by using boost in Flight Mode to travel, then switching to Destroyer Mode for melee attacks against enemies. Boost drains the boost gauge. Once it runs out, you cannot boost again for a short time.

entries.en: Different enemies appear on the battlefield. Use rapid-firing rifles and machine guns against large groups, and blades or rockets against powerful foes. Firing increases the gauge at the bottom-left of the screen. When it reaches its maximum, the weapon overheats and cannot fire for a while. The gauge decreases over time, but some ranged weapons overheat after just one shot.
